ayahs.1: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. He is Most Capable of everything.
ayahs.2: He created death and life to test which of you is best in deeds. He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving.
ayahs.3: He created seven heavens, one above another. You will not see any flaw in the creation of the Rahman. Look again—do you see any imperfection?
ayahs.4: Then look again and again—your sight will return humbled and weary.
ayahs.5: We adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and made them missiles against eavesdropping devils, for whom We prepared the torment of the Blaze.
ayahs.6: Those who disbelieve in their Rabb will suffer the punishment of Hell. What an evil destination.
ayahs.7: When they are thrown into it, they will hear its roaring as it boils over,
ayahs.8: almost bursting in fury. Each time a group is cast in, its keepers will ask: 'Did a warner not come to you?'
ayahs.9: They will reply: 'Yes, a warner came—but we denied and said: Allah has revealed nothing. You are extremely astray.'
ayahs.10: They will lament: 'If only we had listened and reasoned, we would not be among the people of the Blaze.'
ayahs.11: So they will confess their sins. Away with the people of the Blaze.
ayahs.12: Those who stand in awe of their Rabb without having seen Him will have forgiveness and a mighty reward.
ayahs.13: Whether you speak secretly or openly, He knows best what is hidden in the heart.
ayahs.14: How could He not know His own creation? He alone is the Most Subtle, All-Aware.
ayahs.15: He smoothed the earth for you—move through its regions and eat from His provision. To Him is the resurrection of all.
ayahs.16: Do you feel secure that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you as it quakes?
ayahs.17: Or do you feel secure that He will not unleash upon you a storm of stones? Then you would know how serious My warning was.
ayahs.18: Those before them denied as well—then how severe was My response.
ayahs.19: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading and folding their wings? None holds them up except the Rahman. He is All-Seeing of everything.
ayahs.20: What force will help you besides the Rahman? The those who reject the truth are lost in delusion.
ayahs.21: Or who will provide for you if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in arrogance and aversion to the truth.
ayahs.22: Who is rightly guided: the one who crawls facedown, or the one who walks upright on the Straight Path?
ayahs.23: Say: 'He is the One Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect—yet you hardly give shukr, gratitude shown in word and action.'
ayahs.24: Say: 'He is the One Who dispersed you over the earth, and to Him you will all be gathered.'
ayahs.25: They ask: 'When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?'
ayahs.26: Say: 'That knowledge is with Allah alone. I am only sent with a clear warning.'
ayahs.27: When they see the torment drawing near, the faces of the those who reject the truth will darken, and it will be said: 'This is what you claimed would never come.'
ayahs.28: Say: 'Consider: whether Allah causes me and those with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the those who reject the truth from a painful punishment?'
ayahs.29: Say: 'He is the Rahman—in Him alone we believe, and in Him alone we trust. You will soon know who is clearly astray.'
ayahs.30: Say: 'Consider: if your water sank into the earth, who else could bring you flowing water?'
